description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Short walk to the beach- Private pool - Gas grill- 5 adult bikes- YouTube TV- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: At the highest point on the Emerald Coast lies the sun-filled community of Blue Mountain Beach, where the 5-bedroom, 3.5-bathroom Better on Betty is located. This stunning property offers ample space for 14 guests and includes a private pool, covered outdoor patio, and on-site parking for 4 vehicles in the driveway. Only a 5-minute walk to the nearest public beach access, this home provides easy access to the mesmerizing Gulf waters.This 2-story property features an open-concept, first-floor layout with elegant beach decor throughout. A guest bedroom is off a bright and spacious corridor that leads to a luxurious great room, which is illuminated by natural light through its many windows. The gourmet kitchen—complete with KitchenAid stainless-steel appliances, including a freestanding ice maker—is perfect for any homemade family dinner. But for a quick bite, try the large kitchen island/breakfast bar with 6 stools. A comfortable living area offers plenty of seating with an oversized linen sectional and 2 matching armchairs. Watch YouTube TV for entertainment before enjoying a sit-down dinner at the 8-seat distressed wood table. From here, head outside to a covered patio or the private pool.At the top of the switchback stairs, guests will find a flex space with a queen sleeper sofa and 1 bunk bed. Down the hall are the remaining 4 guest bedrooms—1 primary bedroom with a private bath, 1 bunk room with twin-over-twin beds, and 2 guest rooms with a Jack-and-Jill connecting bathroom. There is also a full-sized washer and dryer.Better on Betty is the perfect 30A vacation home to escape the hustle and bustle of everyday life! From 5 included adult bikes to an outdoor grill for cookouts, guests will have all the amenities needed for a stress-free retreat. Book Better on Betty now!
